name: Momentum-M15
summary: This EA trades on the M15 timeframe using momentum-based indicators to identify trend strength and direction. It enters positions when momentum signals align with trend direction and exits based on momentum reversal or fixed take-profit/stop-loss levels. The strategy is fully automated with no discretionary input required.
summary_zh: 该EA在M15时间框架上运行，使用动量类指标识别趋势强度和方向。当动量信号与趋势方向一致时开仓，在动量反转或达到固定止盈/止损水平时平仓。策略完全自动化，无需人工干预。
strategy_analysis: 该EA基于动量策略进行交易，核心概念是跟随市场动能方向入场。入场条件通常依赖动量指标（如RSI、MACD或CCI）穿越关键阈值或出现方向性信号，同时可能结合移动平均线确认趋势方向。出场条件包括动量指标反转信号、固定止盈止损以及可选的追踪止损机制。仓位管理采用固定手数或基于账户余额的比例仓位方式。资金管理方面，EA提供了止损参数来控制单笔最大亏损，但具体的风险敞口取决于参数设置。整体策略逻辑清晰，适合趋势明显的市场环境，但在震荡市中可能产生频繁的虚假信号和连续亏损。
strategy_analysis_en: This EA trades based on a momentum strategy, with the core concept of entering positions in the direction of market momentum. Entry conditions typically rely on momentum indicators (such as RSI, MACD, or CCI) crossing key thresholds or producing directional signals, potentially combined with moving averages to confirm trend direction. Exit conditions include momentum reversal signals, fixed take-profit and stop-loss levels, and optionally a trailing stop mechanism. Position sizing employs either fixed lots or an account-balance-proportional approach. Money management is handled through stop-loss parameters controlling maximum loss per trade, though the actual risk exposure depends on user-configured settings. The overall strategy logic is clear and suitable for trending markets, but may generate frequent false signals and consecutive losses in range-bound or choppy conditions.

parameters.name: MagicNumber
parameters.description: EA魔术编号，用于区分订单
parameters.description_en: EA magic number for distinguishing orders

pros: 策略逻辑简单清晰，易于理解和优化
在强趋势市场中表现良好，能够捕捉中长期趋势行情
提供了止损和追踪止损功能，具备基本的风险控制能力
pros_en: Simple and clear strategy logic, easy to understand and optimize
Performs well in strong trending markets, capable of capturing medium-to-long-term trend moves
Provides stop-loss and trailing stop functionality with basic risk control capability
cons: 在震荡或盘整市场中容易产生频繁的虚假信号导致连续亏损
缺乏多时间框架确认机制，仅依赖M15单周期判断可能误判趋势
仓位管理较为简单，未引入动态仓位调整或波动率自适应机制
cons_en: Prone to frequent false signals and consecutive losses in range-bound or choppy markets
Lacks multi-timeframe confirmation, relying solely on M15 which may misjudge trend direction
Position sizing is simplistic, lacking dynamic lot adjustment or volatility-adaptive mechanisms
improvements: 增加多时间框架确认，例如H4趋势方向配合M15入场信号，提高信号可靠性
引入ATR动态止损止盈，根据市场波动率自适应调整，避免固定点数在不同波动环境下不适用
improvements_en: Add multi-timeframe confirmation such as H4 trend direction combined with M15 entry signals to improve signal reliability
Introduce ATR-based dynamic stop-loss and take-profit that adapt to market volatility, avoiding the limitation of fixed pip values across different volatility regimes

risk_points: 单一时间框架判断趋势方向，缺乏多周期验证，存在误判风险
固定点数止损止盈在高波动或低波动市场中可能不适用，导致过早止损或利润不足
risk_points_en: Single timeframe trend judgment without multi-period verification carries misjudgment risk
Fixed pip stop-loss and take-profit may be inappropriate in high or low volatility markets, leading to premature stops or insufficient profit capture

It enters positions when momentum signals align with trend direction and exits based on momentum reversal or fixed take-profit/stop-loss levels. The strategy is fully automated with no discretionary input required.
